notes.title: Version 1.2 Sneak-Peek #1
notes.notes:
Hey there, fellow Dungeon Builders!

I hope you're all doing well. I know many of you have been patiently waiting for news about our next content update, and honestly, that patience means the world to us.

The team and I have been working hard on this update, and I'm excited to share that we've finally reached the testing phase! Unfortunately, we didn't hit our Q2 timeline like we'd hoped, and I know that's disappointing. We felt that frustration too.

What we've been crafting during this extended period is something we're genuinely excited about, and I think you will be too. I wanted to start sharing some of what we've been up to, beginning with something pretty special: OVERSEER SKILLS!

These new abilities will unlock through your research panel, giving you fascinating ways to influence the heroes' journeys – sometimes helping them along, sometimes... well, let's just say making things more interesting. Take a look at these icons and see if you can figure out what each skill might do. I'd love to hear your guesses!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/bc1c9989be603e9c37c2595bc79dced727faa2f5.png"]

This is just the beginning of what we have in store. More reveals coming soon...

Thanks for sticking with us through this journey. Your support keeps us going.

notes.title: Dungeon Tycoon 1.1 Update Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

The 1.1 update including  new game modes, a new hero class (the Priest), a new map, new quest tiers and more, is out now! To make this launch even better, the game is 35% off! 🎉

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2400770/Dungeon_Tycoon/

The Executive, a movie industry tycoon game also published by Goblinz, is launching today! So, we've partnered up with the devs for a bundle that includes both games. With it, you get an extra 10% discount on both games!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/50423/Dungeon_Tycoon__The_Executive/

v1.1 Full Patch Notes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/e4695f54097869f482d3b8ce558a9edb12a563cc.png

MAJOR FEATURES
 Option to dynamically lower walls to allow more visibility
 Endless quest rewards
 One-way doors that let heroes in but not out (unlocked through research nodes)
 Polymorph trap (unlocked through research) that turn the heroes into a chicken for some time
 Keybinding
 New map: "Overgrown Cave"
 New quest tiers (floor textures, grid objects)
 9 new achievements
 New hero class: Priest (does areal healing/shielding)
 Game modes: Creative, Relaxed, Survival:
Creative: everything is unlocked, endless money, endless souls.
 Relaxed: regular gameplay.
 Survival: Heroes are weaker, refunds are harder, vendors and monsters have upkeep, finishing the day in debt ends the game. Steam deck compatibility
 2 new supported languages: Thai and Hungarian

MINOR FEATURES
 Hero groups now use a shared energy level
 Added tooltips to difficulty settings indicating the game parameters changes
 Heroes now complain about long queues
 3 new monster limit research nodes
 Bosses can now be upgraded
 Double-clicking on a hero will now make the camera follow it
 Turn one-way doors on/off
 Mimic chest (that can harm the hero looting it)

IMPROVEMENTS
 On the first launch, the game is set to the system language if available
 Hero behavior is more randomized
 The camera has been reworked to feel more natural
 Shift now makes movement faster rather than slower
 UI/UX improvements and polishing
 Fixed door direction indicators to be more understandable
 Rooms now have a "souls yesterday" stat
 Added a reset to the default settings button
 Added a setting for zoom sensitivity
 Added tooltips to locked maps on how to unlock the map
 Fixed the horizontal/vertical sensitivity settings
 Low health thoughts get removed when the Hero is healed
 Popup on deleting enhanced vendors, to indicate that the souls will not be refunded
 An option has been added to not pick anything after summoning monsters
 The loot goblin is now invulnerable when the game is paused

FIXES
 AI fixes
 Finance panel UI has been fixed
 Wooden door opening animations have been fixed
 Fixed a bug where the audio would bug out when hovering on the edge of a button
 Fixed a bug where a hero would spawn the "no place to rest" though even if he had energy potions
 Fixed a bug where the quest notification would stay on
 Fixed a bug where a hero would die instantly upon leaving the defense totem proximity

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/314a6fafac64c15b9c6b0179339cbf3205bfc40f.png

Have fun everyone, and feel free to give your feedback here on Steam or on our Discord server!

notes.title: Update 1.0.8

Thanks again for playing Dungeon Tycoon!

Update 1.0.8 Full patchnote 

General Bugfixes :

 Fixed a bug where Monsters were roaming out of the room they were in

notes.title: Update 1.0.7
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We're back with version 1.0.7. We keep on reading your feedback and fixing different issues, so just like everytime, thank you all! Should you have further feedback, we're of course very happy to read it. For now, please find the full patchnote just here : 

Update 1.0.7 changelog

Bugfixes

 Fixed bug when heroes would enter the dungeon even if they don't have enough money
 Fixed bug where skeleton raid skeletons would not open the door
 Fixed Satisfaction impact in rooms not getting loaded
 Fixed a bug where Skeletons from the raid event were not getting into the dungeon
 Fixed a bug where the Level up achievement was not properly granted
 Fixed a bug where heroes behaved like their inventory was full when it wasn't 

Balancing

 Rebirth stone now has unlimited capacity
 Enhanced totems now give 15% stronger buffs
 Potion dispensers are now reusable
 UI improvements for respawn pedestals/spawners

Quality of Life/Other changes

 Difficulty levels on new game panel now have tooltips to indicate what they change
 When a boss is unlocked monster limit will be increased by one
 "Go to" button for monsters when you click on "assigned" indicator
 Assign monster tip is now more readable
 Enhanced totems now preview the enhancement
 Camera fixes
 Chest loot distribution reworked to be more understandable
 Unlock realm button can now be found on research panel
 General improvements to hero AI
 General UI Improvements

Here's the full patchnote :

notes.title: Update 1.0.5 + Roadmap announcement!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today, I've got two things to tell you! Let's get to it right away.

First of all, we've seen that some of your are having concerns about game content. We've got a roadmap about content that will come in the next updates. Please find it at the end of this post! Since I've got more things to tell you and that the team made a beautiful visual for it, I'd want to keep your attention before you're diving into it!
As a precision, the content that's in this roadmap is planned as free content!

As the post title suggests, we're also rolling out the 1.0.5 patch! The main highlights of this patch is that we're keeping on working on crashes. Some of you had crashes on launch and we've tackle some of them. We're still working on some situations where it could still happen. We've also tackled some in-game crashes

One last thing before going into the full patchnote and roadmap, the 1.0.5 should be Steamdeck Compatible, but not finished yet as it's planned to be complete in 1.1 update.
In other words, before 1.0.5 you basically could not even launch the game on Steamdeck. The build should now be launchable on Steamdeck, but not optimized yet. There is a Steam Forum Post about the Steamdeck, since while we know what it requires to be Steam verified with Steam verifications, we're also taking requests and feedback from you, the players, to have more than just the theory

Alright, I think I told you everything I had to, so please find below both the full patch note and the Roadmap!

Thanks for playing Dungeon Tycoon, and as always, for your precious feedback

1.0.5 Patchnote
Crash Fixes :

 Fixed many in-game crashes and bugs
 Fixed some of the startup crashes
 Fixed golden crawler crashes
 Made the crash panel show only once

General Bugfixes :

 Fixed bestiary achievement
 Fixed ultrawide issues
 Fixed large potion dispensers being used less

Other changes

 Major performance upgrades to AI
 Rebalanced legendary heroes
 Added missing monsters to the bestiary
 Added luminosity to camping spots
 Camping spots will now be used at 50% energy minimum instead of 75%
 Added tooltips to chests, room UI

Known issue

 The issue making a room unreachable if the door has been placed before the room itself is only partially fixed. The full fix should come with the next update, 1.0.6. As a workaround, you can save and reload your save, it will make the room reachable.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44097891/43d67157dc2ef3c2232258a09d3ea0e1c7b40af6.png

notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Here's our second patch for Dungeon Tycoon! Since most of the crash situations seem to be fixed, we're focusing a bit more on balancing the experience.
Some people might still have crashes ; we're currently investigating on a compatibility issue for people using DirectX11/Windows 7. While using those does not mean you'll have crashes, this might be a cause of the remain ones. If you still have crashes but are not using DirectX11/Windows 7, please remember to have a look at the  Steam Forum's Crashes thread, so you can send your Crash logs our way to fix those! Thanks a lot

For this patch, as said, we're focusing a bit on balancing as we did not expect people to fly through the game's content. As we cannot add content that fast, to optimize the experience, we're slowing a bit the player's progression through it
There's also a bunch of bug fixes in there too. 
Thanks again for all your reports, I know I'm saying it a lot, but this is truly essential for us to give everyone the best experience possible.

Have a wonderful day, and please find the full patch note below :

Balancing

 Popularity rebalancing
 Room prices were increased
 Balancing to research
 Nerfed groups by 25%

General Bugfixes

 Added the two missing monsters to the spawn pool
 Fixed improved camping spots
 Fixed placing a room after placing a door wouldnt detect the room as reachable
 Fixes to achivements
 Fixes to old saves saying 97% on the research panel instead of 100%

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 - Crashes & bugfixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

First of all, thanks a lot for the warm welcome you gave the game. We're really thrilled that you are really hype about it!
However, the launch itself was not perfect. Some people are having a lot of crashes, sometimes with in-game pop-up, sometimes just with a Unity pop-up, but no matter how they ended up happenning ; this is far from ideal.
The main issue there was that we couldn't really reproduce the crashes on our test environments. However, thanks to you and your feedback, there's a lot of them we were able to tackle down (I don't want to say all of them for the obvious reason that we never really know, right). Moreover, we'd rather deploy this patch fixing a lot of the crashes as fast as possible, even if some might still be here, rather than waiting longer and having a lot of people experiencing the game negatively

If any crash situations happens again, please have a look at the Steam Forum's pinned thread where there's a procedure on how you can send us your crash logs to help us take care of the remaining ones, shold there be some. Please note that even though we've tested this patch on our side, we also did for the game's launch, so we do apologize in advance should you still have trouble. We're doing our best to prevent this from happenning

Please find the full 1.0.2 patchnote below

Once again, we sincerly apologize to people that had those crashes, preventing them from having fun at all. Thanks a lot for playing Dungeon Tycoon, and see you for the next update(s)!

Patch 1.0.2 Changelog :

Crashes fixes

 Fixed general unity crashes (Updated Unity)
 Fixed an in-game crash from arrow rain skill from rangers
 Fixed an in-game crash from combat
 Fix quit to desktop sometimes crashing
 Fix crashes from outlines on VFX

General bugs

 Fixed reached 5 star message and achievement not showing sometimes
 Fixed wrong percentage completion in the research tree
 Fixed heroes getting bugged after killing a loot goblin sometimes
 Fixes campfires ramdomly not being used
 Fixed achievement for researching the first research page

Other changes

 Added better diagnostics
 Capped the FPS to 144 until we have a configurable UI (this was potentially causing crashes too)

notes.title: New demo update and publishing!
notes.notes:
The Goblinz Publishing team is excited to bring you some thrilling news! We're delighted to announce that we are partnering with Lunheim Studios, the talented developers behind Dungeon Tycoon, to take the game to the next level! We can't wait to share more news about our plans, but in the meantime, please enjoy the latest version of the demo - available now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2400770/Dungeon_Tycoon/

FULL PATCH NOTES:

Major Content

-Added new monsters.
-Added new buildable objects.
-Added new quest rewards.
-Added new research perks.
-Added a new class: The Wizard!
-Added ranged attacks for heroes.
-Added the loot goblin event.
-Made rooms inspectable.
-Room floors and walls can now be customized.
-Rooms can now be deleted.
-Hero AI has been completely reworked to allow for more natural decision making.
-Added item inspection panel to the build menu to show descriptions about the objects.
-Added a graph chart on the finances panel.

Other Changes

-Deleting objects now refund money.
-Added tooltips.
-Added more rooms stats.
-Respawn pedestal now has a set amount of charges.
-Every hero now can give only one soul.
-Heroes can now be marked to follow them easier.
-Improved in-game camera.
-Switched to an improved input system.
-Improved scene lighting.
-Rebalanced some objects.
-Monsters now glow when they are max level.
-Overall performance has been improved.
-New icons for research perks.
-Everything is made easier to click and selects with larger hitboxes.
-New hero positioning system to make sure they don't overlap during fights.
-Added "View Monster" button to spawners.
-Visual UI improvements.
-Outline system for selections.
-Double door support.
-New hero gear.
-Right clicking now closes any open panel.
-Fights are made smoother.
-Doors now can be rotated.
-Log system.
-Ability to zoom in/out on the research panel.
-Totems now keep casting buffs as long as the heroes stay inside.
-1,2,3 and space keys for time controls.
-Improved the majority of the VFX.
-Lots of small QoL changes.

Bug Fixes

-Fixed UI issues.
-Fixed potion dispenser bugs.
-Fixed heroes not facing the enemies.
-Fixed various bugs with the build system.
-Fixed flashing lights on torches.
-Fixed object options offset issues.
-Fixed floating texts not being positioned correctly.
-Fixed game-breaking bugs with the summoning system.
-Fixed enemies escaping rooms.
-Fixed monster spawn rates.

Known Issues

-You can buy three monsters at the beginning, and then you have no gold and can't continue. If this happens to you, we invite you to start a new game.

For any questions or feedback, feel free to join the Lunheim Studios' Discord server. We're expecting many of you there!

Have fun!
